questions.solution_html:
• Distinguish between a thick lens and a thin lens. [U] / [CO4]
  • ANS: A lens is considered "thin" if its thickness is negligible compared to: (1) The radii of curvature of its
  • two surfaces. (2) The distances of objects and images from the lens.
  • A thick lens is a physically large lens where thickness between its two spherical surfaces is not
  • negligible compared to the radii of curvature of those surfaces. Essentially, its thickness is significant
  • compared to its focal length.
